positive.point: Integration of approval workflows within Delinea PAM system for seamless access management.
Open source governance layer for AI agent actions aligns with upcoming regulations like FINRA 2026 and EU AI Act.
Cartography tool now inventories AI agents and maps them to IAM roles, enhancing visibility and security.
Regular audits and reviews in Google Workspace security help maintain least privilege and compliance.

negative.point: Lack of visibility and governance for legacy and shadow applications in IGA systems.
AI agents often have unclear ownership and overly broad permissions, posing security risks.
Unused permissions in AI agents create a significant security threat due to their continuous operation.
Service accounts created by former employees remain active, posing security risks due to lack of ownership and lifecycle management.
AI agents lack identity governance, leading to unmanaged access and security gaps.
